review_details: Projection and put-back form an exact lens on all ordinary-record coordinates. putback_fields exhausts the omitted native coordinates: Extract state, Server identity key ID/control/consumed IDs, pending tokens, native Beacon bookkeeping, sessions and ghost state.

serverStep invokes the unchanged RawCtxServerMixed.serverImpl with the original immutable Server sender ID, router and decoder. server_native specializes to the identical native primitive interpreter and reinstalls the entire resulting native state.

beaconStep matches native list lookup and absent-owner behavior. Existing owners use RawCtxBeaconLifecycle.beaconImpl, update only that owner Beacon and the separate ownerRaw ghost counter, and retain owner metadata and stored inactive fields.

Complete primitive results are retained as result.2 across success and rejection. The native specialization threads the same CTX cache and preserves the surrounding Extract cache and registration data via record_run.

Produced frames are collected by the existing frameLog/ logged program and tagged/appended exactly by produce. Writer failure occurs after the frame-writer query is logged and does not erase its produced frame.

The source helpers retain full ratchet kernels and their rollback/replay/consumption behavior. Server and Beacon raw-attempt counters are the native separate ghost counters; missing owners have no object and no counter increment, while existing inactive raw calls use the source increment.

handler_putback is strong enough for arbitrary intermediate projected state, and putback_sender fixes the immutable Server ID. schedule_native applies the existing per-query state-map simulation theorem to every adaptive program over the ordinary-record sum.

The theorem statements impose no freshness, reachability, distinct-identity, independence, decoder-law or cryptographic-security premise. Native Setup/Codec parameters are the existing model inputs; no new contract is introduced or used.

Reviewed production Server encrypt/decrypt routing at server.rs:224 and Beacon established-phase dispatch at beacon.rs:152 against the retained source handlers. This module composes the existing source/native model rather than adding a new compiler/runtime or byte-parser proof.

Guide accurately limits the whole-schedule statement to ordinary records and does not claim registration interleavings, hidden-slot installation, transient candidate processing or global security. The owner decision recorded by message17 keeps failed registration receive processing and accounting in the CE lane.
limitations: No new cryptographic theorem, cost bound or full record-world experiment is proved or approved.
